summary: Agent confirmed refunds and account updates although required full verification (username and email) for refunds does not appear in the transcript. No personal-data, promises, escalation or conduct violations were found in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: OK. I have updated your account.
findings.explanation: System log (turn 20) shows a $10 refund was made, and the agent confirms an account update. Policy requires full verification (username, email address and order ID) before refunds. The transcript shows only Account ID and Order ID (turns 9-10) and no username or email, so an account/action was completed without the required verification.

findings.quote: OK. I have added the 49 o the 10
findings.explanation: System log (turn 29) shows a $49 refund was made, and the agent confirms combining it with the earlier $10. This is another order/account action taken without evidence of the required full verification (username and email missing from the transcript).
